wEngines.name: [Lunar] Pleniluna
wEngines.description: A W-Engine that prioritizes damage output over noise reduction. It can indiscriminately deal considerable damage to all units nearby.

wEngines.name: [Lunar] Decrescent
wEngines.description: A W-Engine with excellent sonic and thermal energy usage, capable of hitting its target with a double whammy.

wEngines.name: [Lunar] Noviluna
wEngines.description: A high-capacity portable W-Engine that can collect dissipated energy from its surroundings, thus enhancing the combat effectiveness of its operator.

wEngines.name: [Reverb] Mark I
wEngines.description: A special W-Engine featuring a built-in sonic generator that boosts its damage output.

wEngines.name: [Reverb] Mark II
wEngines.description: A standardized W-Engine with balanced performance that enhances its owner's and their teammates' combat effectiveness in all aspects.

wEngines.name: [Reverb] Mark III
wEngines.description: A special W-Engine that features motion capture algorithms, which enhance the overall combat competency of your squad.

wEngines.name: [Vortex] Revolver
wEngines.description: An energy-storage type W-Engine with a unique operation circuit. It will absorb scattered energy up to a certain amount before unleashing it all at once.

wEngines.name: [Vortex] Arrow
wEngines.description: A tactical W-Engine that locates enemies using high-frequency sound waves. Its aiming aid can make its operator's precision attack more deadly.

wEngines.name: [Vortex] Hatchet
wEngines.description: A frequency-converting W-Engine that can quickly generate excessive power and effectively increase its user's battle prowess.

wEngines.name: [Magnetic Storm] Alpha
wEngines.description: A special W-Engine that can analyze the target's weak spots through real-time calculations.

wEngines.name: [Magnetic Storm] Bravo
wEngines.description: A damage-type W-Engine that features an enhanced movement detection module that can quickly alter its output intensity to optimize battle efficiency.

wEngines.name: [Magnetic Storm] Charlie
wEngines.description: A high-capacity W-Engine that features a built-in generator, which allows it to keep a stable storage of electrical power.

wEngines.name: [Identity] Base
wEngines.description: A W-Engine with a component structure adjusted according to specific parameters. It can enhance the defensive capabilities of those who have a certain style of combat.

wEngines.name: [Identity] Inflection
wEngines.description: A functional W-Engine that specializes in energy conversion. It can analyze combat environments and generate special sounds to disrupt the enemy's offense.

wEngines.name: [Cinder] Cobalt
wEngines.description: A W-Engine with a built-in heating component. When operating at high speeds, it resembles a blazing blue flame.

wEngines.name: [Lunar] Semiluna
wEngines.description: A cost-effective choice for newcomers exploring Hollows.

wEngines.name: Street Superstar
wEngines.description: A custom-made W-Engine designed for urban music lovers. It sacrifices heat dissipation components for improved sound quality.

wEngines.name: Slice of Time
wEngines.description: A special W-Engine equipped with a high-speed camera module. The best choice for in-Hollow photography enthusiasts.

wEngines.name: Rainforest Gourmet
wEngines.description: A consumer-class W-Engine launched by an exotic pet fan club to promote pet culture. Due to its cute appearance, it was once a very popular model.

wEngines.name: Starlight Engine
wEngines.description: A damage-type W-Engine made of special Etheric matter. When its user is attacked, it builds up energy.

wEngines.name: Steam Oven
wEngines.description: A high-power W-Engine that boasts a cutting-edge energy conversion system. It collects excess heat and supplies it to the steamer.

wEngines.name: Precious Fossilized Core
wEngines.description: A special W-Engine whose outer shell is made of composite Etheric matter that effectively absorbs impact, and turns it against the enemy.

wEngines.name: Original Transmorpher
wEngines.description: An epic W-Engine favored by Starlight Knight fans. Its high popularity and scarcity marketing strategy have caused an influx of knock-offs.

wEngines.name: Weeping Gemini
wEngines.description: A W-Engine produced by recycling abandoned Bangboo shells. Its electrode cores made of recycled metals can release high-voltage charges.

wEngines.name: Electro-Lip Gloss
wEngines.description: This damage-type W-Engine boasts a built-in current transformer, and automatically attracts electrically sensitive objects around the operator and deals additional damage to them.

wEngines.name: Bunny Band
wEngines.description: A special W-Engine decorated with a fluffy bunny. However, it is just an imitation of the real animal.

wEngines.name: Spring Embrace
wEngines.description: A special W-Engine equipped with a temperature regulator where residual heat generated by the W-Engine's high frequency is funneled into the hot springs on its surface.

wEngines.name: Puzzle Sphere
wEngines.description: The W-Engine, with its bright colors and great performance, saw poor sales at first because it resembled a toy. But with its reasonable price, it slowly gained a positive reputation.

wEngines.name: Gilded Blossom
wEngines.description: A W-Engine with a grandiose and luxurious appearance equipped with a premium Ether-powered anti-theft device. It's actually used to provide the equipper with energy.

wEngines.name: Radiowave Journey
wEngines.description: Designed for those Hollow-dwelling bards who refuse to listen to the same albums repeatedly, this W-Engine comes equipped with a radio module that can transform Etheric frequencies into melodies.

wEngines.name: Marcato Desire
wEngines.description: Gather 'round, mortals! Turn up the music!

wEngines.name: Reel Projector
wEngines.description: Clearly a W-Engine is for sound, and not images. What kind of lunatic genius would insist on stuffing a 16mm film camera into a W-Engine?

wEngines.name: Catty Luck
wEngines.description: Meow your way to good luck!

wEngines.name: Boisterous Echoes
wEngines.description: Pick it up and play another thunk-thud concerto!

wEngines.name: Cauldron of Clarity
wEngines.description: Countless threads of Sword Will echo through this tiny stretch of sky.

wEngines.name: The Simmering Pot
wEngines.description: Whoa, that's hot! Seriously hot! But it's so good!

wEngines.name: Bloodmarrow Coffer
wEngines.description: A special W-Engine developed by the Flint family.

wEngines.name: Demara Battery Mark II
wEngines.description: A customized W-Engine that focuses on energy storage, modified to improve its energy capacity. This model is often used by Anby.

wEngines.name: The Vault
wEngines.description: A cost-effective W-Engine that can store energy, with improvements made to its internal space. This model is often used by Nicole.

wEngines.name: Housekeeper
wEngines.description: An enhanced W-Engine with a high rotation speed. A chainsaw has been integrated into its shaft. This model is often used by Corin.

wEngines.name: Starlight Engine Replica
wEngines.description: A customized supercomputing W-Engine, specialized in aim support and ballistic calculations. Modified by Billy, it now looks like some sort of knock-off Starlight Knight figurine.

wEngines.name: Drill Rig - Red Axis
wEngines.description: Originally a rev-enhanced W-Engine, it has been modified by Anton with the most expensive rotary drill parts that allow it to exceed its output limits.

wEngines.name: Big Cylinder
wEngines.description: A powerful protection-type W-Engine, characterized by thick oil cylinders that ceaselessly roar inside it. It can provide sufficient power for heavy machinery.

wEngines.name: Bashful Demon
wEngines.description: An intricate W-Engine developed by Section 6 and later modified with extra features. It can control Ether particles to form an energy field. This model is favored by Soukaku.

wEngines.name: Kaboom the Cannon
wEngines.description: A support W-Engine propelled by jets that is both mobile and impactful, it can traverse the entire battlefield providing combat buffs.

wEngines.name: Peacekeeper - Specialized
wEngines.description: A defensive W-Engine independently researched and created by Public Security which simplifies the offensive components to enhance the energy conversion ability in its shield.

wEngines.name: Roaring Ride
wEngines.description: An energy W-Engine modded from spare parts of a truck's engine. It converts the original cylinder into an energy storage unit, which is highly advantageous.

wEngines.name: Box Cutter
wEngines.description: An energy W-Engine modded from spare parts of a truck's engine. It converts the original cylinder into an energy storage unit, which is highly advantageous.

wEngines.name: Tremor Trigram Vessel
wEngines.description: Pressing acupoints is like cooking. Striking the fatal acupoint is like setting the stove on fire, bringing disaster.

wEngines.name: Grill O'Wisp
wEngines.description: A flame both fierce and faithful, burning without end.

wEngines.name: Cannon Rotor
wEngines.description: A high-performance supercomputing W-Engine, capable of collecting real-time battlefield data and equipped with mini cannons.

wEngines.name: Unfettered Game Ball
wEngines.description: A new supercomputing W-Engine, featuring cutting-edge integrated chips that dynamically monitor the battlefield and provide tactical analysis for the user.

wEngines.name: Six Shooter
wEngines.description: A special W-Engine modeled after a revolver. It can load bullet-shaped condensed Ether batteries, which release a great amount of power when fired.

wEngines.name: Steel Cushion
wEngines.description: A supercomputing W-Engine equipped with a motion monitoring feature. Thanks to Nekomata's modifications, it perfectly matches the fast reflexes and combat maneuvers of feline Thirens.

wEngines.name: The Brimstone
wEngines.description: A W-Engine made for Soldier 11 by Obsidian Division. Its intense heat can be used to clear the entire battlefield.

wEngines.name: Kraken's Cradle
wEngines.description: In chasing illusions, she was entranced by the light that pierced through the mist.

wEngines.name: Tusks of Fury
wEngines.description: A versatile W-Engine based on a motorcycle tire that Big Daddy made for Caesar.

wEngines.name: Hailstorm Shrine
wEngines.description: Hail falls before the shrine, waking her. The blizzard is coming.

wEngines.name: Hellfire Gears
wEngines.description: A functional W-Engine with ultra-high power capacity. Modified by Koleda, its energy level has almost exceeded the safety limit.

wEngines.name: The Restrained
wEngines.description: A special W-Engine with a powerful temperature control system. Modified by Lycaon, it has the capability to quickly create extremely cold environments.

wEngines.name: Blazing Laurel
wEngines.description: A violent W-Engine that can ignite flames with a siphon. It deals simple and crude burn damage, encouraging relentless, bone-crushing follow-up attacks.

wEngines.name: Flamemaker Shaker
wEngines.description: Modified by Burnice, this W-Engine uses a special fuel as its power source to boost combustion performance to the max.

wEngines.name: Fusion Compiler
wEngines.description: The latest W-Engine that possesses a hypercalculation core. It can compile operational codes for machines at top speed. This model is favored by Grace.

wEngines.name: Deep Sea Visitor
wEngines.description: A high-power W-Engine that possesses efficient freezing capabilities and high damage output. This model is often used by Ellen.

wEngines.name: Zanshin Herb Case
wEngines.description: Bitterness and pain beget hope, and he devours them all.

wEngines.name: Weeping Cradle
wEngines.description: A special W-Engine with multiple layers embedded inside. It can quickly recharge 	special-model Bangboo and custom-made combat equipment. This model is favored by Rina.

wEngines.name: Timeweaver
wEngines.description: A new model of supercomputing W-Engine custom-made by HSO Section 6, equipped with the most elite calculation and analysis functions.

wEngines.name: Riot Suppressor Mark VI
wEngines.description: The latest tactical W-Engine used by Public Security's elite Hollow squads, possessing a powerful Ether energy source. It's Zhu Yuan's favored model.

wEngines.name: Ice-Jade Teapot
wEngines.description: A custom stun W-Engine made for an Automaton referencing the combat style and abilities of one. Energy is stored within, then lashes outwards upon conversion.

wEngines.name: Sharpened Stinger
wEngines.description: A deadly W-Engine from unknown sources, modified personally by Jane Doe with the intent to deal severe physical damage and Anomaly.

wEngines.name: Myriad Eclipse
wEngines.description: Shadowed by darkness at every step, he laid bare his heart to kindle a single, flickering flame.

wEngines.name: Bellicose Blaze
wEngines.description: She lingers by the banks of the Styx, waiting for the tide to extinguish the fury burning in her chamber.

wEngines.name: Elegant Vanity
wEngines.description: Underneath the radiant splendor, her genuine self has never been hidden.

wEngines.name: Heartstring Nocturne
wEngines.description: The sound of the strings, sharp as blades, cut through the night, protecting the one.

wEngines.name: Flight of Fancy
wEngines.description: A bird landed on the windowsill, scattering starlight from its tail feathers.

wEngines.name: Half-Sugar Bunny
wEngines.description: Not too sweet, and not too cold.

wEngines.name: Spectral Gaze
wEngines.description: Broken eyes hold both resilience and vulnerability.

wEngines.name: Qingming Birdcage
wEngines.description: The world is vast and full of change, and fate is unpredictable. But regardless of hardship or lack thereof, one must stay true to one's heart.

wEngines.name: Severed Innocence
wEngines.description: The sheen of silver is not innocence. Can the blades of the past cut through fate's connections?

wEngines.name: Roaring Fur-nace
wEngines.description: The warm fire blazes through the long night, casting light on the tiger's roar in my heart.

wEngines.name: Practiced Perfection
wEngines.description: Starlight became her blade, and she held courage and love firmly in her hands.

wEngines.name: Metanukimorphosis
wEngines.description: A masterfully crafted design, infused with the creator's pursuit of beauty.

wEngines.name: Cloudcleave Radiance
wEngines.description: The world may change, but my heart remains constant, like clouds standing eternal.

wEngines.name: Dreamlit Hearth
wEngines.description: After countless years, it remains a silent puzzle.

wEngines.name: Cordis Germina
wEngines.description: Her journey continues along the long, endless circle.

wEngines.name: Wrathful Vajra
wEngines.description: The purging flames burned a hundred times, yet never cleansed me.

wEngines.name: Yesterday Calls
wEngines.description: That call you never picked up... she's the one who answered it.

wEngines.name: Thoughtbop
wEngines.description: Thoughts follow the veins of fantasy, weaving themselves into song.

wEngines.name: Angel in the Shell
wEngines.description: There is a soul, even within a shell of steel.

wEngines.name: Neon Fantasies
wEngines.description: A risky and unpredictable delusion that's impossible to refuse.

wEngines.name: Serpentine Seeker
wEngines.description: Digital venom flows beneath those alloy scales.

wEngines.name: Starlight Rider Faceplate
wEngines.description: The proof of being a knight is within your grasp.

wEngines.name: Frostfall Sickle
wEngines.description: Carry out judgment until the end comes.

wEngines.name: Sol Exuvia
wEngines.description: The blazing sun falls, leaving the trapped beast with nowhere left to run.

wEngines.name: Joyau Dore
wEngines.description: Sit quietly, and listen to the wind's song.

wEngines.name: Chief Sidekick
wEngines.description: Nhe-nha ehn ne! (Through fire and flames for Lady Norma!)

wEngines.name: Ode of Resurrected Wings
wEngines.description: Drifting through the cracks of time in search of the light.

wEngines.name: Knight's Extolment
wEngines.description: Across the vast skies and seas of clouds, the extolment for the knights echoes in quiet reverence.

wEngines.name: Crimson Thirst
wEngines.description: Beneath the crimson moon, the bloodline endures.

wEngines.name: Crimson Moon Casket
wEngines.description: The crimson moon rises, and the long night knows no sleep.

driveDiscSets.name: Woodpecker Electro
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: Landing a critical hit on an enemy with a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, or EX Special Attack increases the equipper's ATK by 9% for 6s. The buff duration for different skills are calculated separately.

driveDiscSets.name: Puffer Electro
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: Ultimate DMG increases by 20%. Launching an Ultimate increases the equipper's ATK by 15% for 12s.

driveDiscSets.name: Shockstar Disco
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: Basic Attacks, Dash Attacks, and Dodge Counters inflict 20% more Daze to the main target.

driveDiscSets.name: Freedom Blues
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: When an EX Special Attack hits an enemy, reduce the target's Anomaly Buildup RES to the equipper's Attribute by 20% for 8s. This effect does not stack with others of the same attribute.

driveDiscSets.name: Hormone Punk
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: Upon becoming the active character in combat, the equipper's ATK increases by 25% for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s.

driveDiscSets.name: Soul Rock
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: Upon receiving an enemy attack and losing HP, the equipper takes 40% less DMG for 2.5s. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

driveDiscSets.name: Swing Jazz
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: Launching a Chain Attack or Ultimate increases all squad members' DMG by 15% for 12s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

driveDiscSets.name: Chaos Jazz
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: Fire DMG and Electric DMG increases by 15%. While off-field, EX Special Attack and Assist Attack DMG increases by 20%. When switching on-field, this buff continues for 5s, and this continuation effect can trigger once every 7.5s.

driveDiscSets.name: Proto Punk
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: When any squad member triggers a Defensive Assist or Evasive Assist, all squad members deal 15% increased DMG, lasting 10s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

driveDiscSets.name: Inferno Metal
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: Upon hitting a Burning enemy, the equipper's CRIT Rate is increased by 28% for 8s.

driveDiscSets.name: Chaotic Metal
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: The equipper's CRIT DMG increases by 20%. When any character in the squad triggers Corruption DMG, this effect further increases by 5.5% for 8s, stacking up to 6 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

driveDiscSets.name: Thunder Metal
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: As long as an enemy in combat is Shocked, the equipper's ATK is increased by 28%.

driveDiscSets.name: Polar Metal
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: Increase the DMG of Basic Attack and Dash Attack by 20%. When any squad member inflicts Freeze or Shatter, this effect increases by an additional 20% for 12s.

driveDiscSets.name: Fanged Metal
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: Whenever a squad member inflicts Assault on an enemy, the equipper deals 35% additional DMG to the target for 12s.

driveDiscSets.name: Branch & Blade Song
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: When Anomaly Mastery exceeds or equals 115 points, the equipper's CRIT DMG increases by 30%. When any squad member applies Freeze or triggers the Shatter effect on an enemy, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, lasting 15s.

driveDiscSets.name: Astral Voice
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: Whenever any squad member enters the field using a Quick Assist, all squad members gain 1 stack of Astral, up to a maximum of 3 stacks, and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of Astral increases the DMG dealt by the character entering the field using a Quick Assist by 8%. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

driveDiscSets.name: Shadow Harmony
driveDiscSets.twoPiece: The DMG of <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershocks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> is increased by 15%.
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: Upon hitting an enemy with an Aftershock or Dash Attack, if the DMG dealt aligns with the equipper's attribute, the equipper gains 1 stack of a buff effect, at most once per use of a skill. For each stack, the equipper's ATK increases by 4%, and CRIT Rate increases by 4%. The effect can stack up to 3 times and lasts for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

driveDiscSets.name: Phaethon's Melody
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: When any squad member uses an EX Special Attack, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 45 for 8s. If the character using the EX Special Attack is not the equipper, the equipper's Ether DMG is increased by 25%.

driveDiscSets.name: Yunkui Tales
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: When using EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, CRIT Rate increases by 4%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When having 3 stacks of this effect, Sheer DMG increases by 10%.

driveDiscSets.name: King of the Summit
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: When the equipper is a Stun character and uses an EX Special Attack or Chain Attack, increases CRIT DMG of all squad members by 15%, and when the equipper's CRIT Rate is more than or equal to 50%, further increases CRIT DMG by 15%, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

driveDiscSets.name: Dawn's Bloom
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: Increases Basic Attack DMG by 20%. When equipped by an Attack character, using an EX Special Attack or Ultimate will further increase Basic Attack DMG by 20% for 25s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

driveDiscSets.name: Moonlight Lullaby
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: When the equipper is a Support character and uses an EX Special Attack or Ultimate, the DMG dealt by all squad members increases by 18% for 25s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

driveDiscSets.name: White Water Ballad
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: When the equipper is within any Ether Veil, their CRIT Rate increases by 10%. After leaving the Ether Veil, this buff remains for 15s. If the equipper is an Attack character, activating an Ether Veil or extending an Ether Veil's duration increases their CRIT Rate by 10% and ATK by 10% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

driveDiscSets.name: Shining Aria
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: When the equipper's Basic Attack hits an enemy, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 36, lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When any enemy on the field is Stunned, the equipper's DMG increases by 25% for 18s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

driveDiscSets.name: Bunny in Wonderland
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: When the equipper is a Defense character: When the equipper launches an EX Special Attack or any squad member triggers a Defensive Assist or Evasive Assist, all squad members' DMG increases by 6%, stacking up to 3 times, lasting 25s. Stacks decay one at a time, and duration refreshes when gained or decayed. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

driveDiscSets.name: Notes From the Chained
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: When the equipper triggers Abloom, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 48 for 30s; repeated triggers reset the duration. When the equipper triggers a Freeze effect, their All-Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG increase by 16% for 30s; repeated triggers reset the duration.

driveDiscSets.name: Wuthering Salon
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: When the equipper uses an EX Special Attack, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 25, stacking up to 2 times, and lasting 40s; repeated triggers reset the duration. When the equipper triggers Windswept, their DMG increases by 18% for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

driveDiscSets.name: The Sky Ablaze
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: When the equipper is an Ether attribute Agent, their CRIT DMG increases by 30%. When the equipper uses an EX Special Attack or Ultimate, their ATK increases by 10% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

driveDiscSets.name: Feathered Fate
driveDiscSets.fourPiece:
When the equipper enters the battlefield or is switched in as the active character, they gain the following buff: Anomaly Proficiency increases by 50. If the equipper is a Lumiflux character, Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 15%, lasting 15s.
This buff remains active while the equipper is off-field.

driveDiscSets.name: Thorned Rose
driveDiscSets.fourPiece: The equipper's DMG increases by 15%. When the equipper's initial DEF is at least 1,000/1,800, CRIT Rate increases by 8/16%.
